name: Speak with Belann

angles.text: Crafting a personal spell focus marks a vital rite of passage for aspiring spellcasters honoring the ancient traditions of the High Order.

faq.answer: Belann Windwood is a master craftsman residing in Valanaar. He has dedicated over a century of his craft to creating staves and wands for members of the High Order.
The High Order is an ancient organization of practitioners whose long-standing traditions include guiding young spellcasters in the construction and mastery of their own spell focuses.
A spell focus, such as a wand or a staff, channels magical energies. Crafting an individual focus is considered one of the oldest rites of passage for developing spellcasters within the High Order.
Valanaar is the settlement where Belann Windwood maintains his workshop and assists students of the High Order with crafting focuses.
As an aspiring magic wielder whose powers are burgeoning, you are sent to Belann to study under his century of expertise and begin the process of shaping your own magical implement.
faq.q: Why are you sent to speak with Belann?

faq.answer: Upon introducing yourself to Belann in Valanaar, the craftsman welcomes you and prepares to explain the next stages involved in assembling your spell focus.
faq.q: What happens after you meet Belann?

sections.body: As an aspiring practitioner's command over magic flourishes, the High Order calls upon ancient custom to test and elevate their talents. Crafting a personalized spell focus—whether in the form of a wand or staff—is considered one of the order's most enduring traditions for students looking to bind their burgeoning power to an implement of their own making.
sections.title: A Rite of Growing Power

sections.body: To undertake this sacred crafting, initiates are directed to Valanaar to seek out Belann Windwood. Renowned for dedicating more than a century to forging exceptional staves and wands for the High Order, Belann acts as a trusted mentor, eager to welcome dedicated students and guide them through the intricate craft and history of their magical tools.
sections.title: The Craftsman of Valanaar

summary: Speak with Belann directs aspiring spellcasters to Valanaar to meet master artisan Belann Windwood. As an initiate's magical mastery expands, crafting a personal spell focus marks an essential rite of passage under the storied traditions of the High Order.
